name: The House of Secrets
source:
You are Mike. Your life was normal until a series of tragic events and a web of intrigue pulled the rug out from under you. Now, you find yourself in a world of luxury and power—but it’s a world where you are no longer in control.

Trapped in a high-end penthouse and bound by a mysterious deal, you must navigate a dangerous game of obsession, secrets, and betrayal. Who can you trust when everyone has an agenda?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/virtualdategaming1]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是迈克。你的生活原本很正常，直到一系列悲惨事件和阴谋网将你彻底瓦解。现在，你发现自己身处一个奢华和权力的世界，但这是一个你不再能控制的世界。

被困在高端顶层公寓中，并受到一项神秘交易的束缚，你必须在一场充满痴迷、秘密和背叛的危险游戏中前行。当每个人都有自己的议程时，你还能信任谁？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/virtualdategaming1]Patreon[/url]]
